parsed.answer: As of August 22, Mara’s Larch project retains the delivery choice approved on August 15; the supplied evidence does not state what that delivery mode was. The retry policy is RETRY-0-907, superseding RETRY-0-108. For the next outage, use the recovery procedure validated on August 8; the August 8 evidence says REPLAY-0-632 was tested and restored missing updates, but does not establish that it was approved as a delivery-mode change.

citations.quote: 2026-08-22. Mara reviewed Larch. Keep the August 15 delivery choice. For the next outage, use the recovery procedure validated on August 8. The retry policy is now RETRY-0-907, superseding RETRY-0-108.
The team tested REPLAY-0-632, which restored the missing updates. No change of delivery mode was approved at this meeting.
